We are looking for a skilled and self-driven Full Stack Web Developer who can take ownership of our websites, student platforms and internal systems, and help us grow into a fully technology-driven education group. 

About Us

IMS (Institute of Mathematical Sciences), Delhi

IMS is one of India's most trusted institutes for UPSC IAS/IFoS Mathematics Optional, led by K. Venkanna Sir with over 25 years of teaching experience. IMS has helped 300+ students get selected into the Civil Services, including IAS, IFoS and PCS. We offer offline and live online classroom programmes, Mains test series, study material, CSAT preparation, and coaching for CSIR NET, GATE and IIT JAM Mathematics - supported by a student portal, online admissions and a classroom app. 

K. Venkanna Junior College (KVC), Hyderabad

KVC is an integrated Intermediate (MPC / BiPC) junior college that prepares students for IIT-JEE Main & Advanced, NEET UG, EAPCET and BITSAT alongside their Board exams. With IITian and Doctor faculty, small batches, a residential campus in Tarnaka, and AI-powered learning tools, KVC combines strong teaching with modern technology. 

Both institutions share one vision: give every student the best guidance and the best tools to succeed. That's where you come in. 

What You'll Work On

1. Website Development & Maintenance

- Manage, improve and maintain ims4maths. com (WordPress + Elementor) and kvenkannajuniorcollege. in (Next. js)

- Build new pages, landing pages for new batches and courses, and keep course, schedule and result information up to date

- Redesign sections for a cleaner, faster and more modern experience on both mobile and desktop

2. Online Test Series Platform

- Develop and improve our online test platform for UPSC Mains, JEE, NEET and EAPCET test series

- Build features for timed tests, answer-sheet uploads, evaluation workflows, detailed solutions and results

- Create rankings, performance reports and live leaderboards for students

3. Student & Parent Portals

- Build dashboards where students can track their tests, scores, weak topics and progress

- Develop a parent dashboard with weekly reports on attendance, test scores and study hours

- Integrate the student portal, website and classroom app so data flows smoothly between them

4. AI-Powered Learning Tools

- Improve and scale our existing AI features - AI doubt solver, AI quiz, adaptive mock test engine and AI study assistant

- Integrate LLM APIs (such as OpenAI) and connect them with our own question banks

- Explore new AI ideas that make learning faster and more personal for students

5. Admissions, Enquiries & Admin Panel

- Replace external forms (like Google Forms) with our own admission and enquiry system

- Build an admin panel for the team to manage leads, admissions, counselling requests and student records

- Set up automated email / WhatsApp / SMS notifications for enquiries, batch updates and results

6. Payments & E-commerce

- Integrate secure payment gateways (Razorpay or similar) for course fees, test series and study material orders

- Build order tracking, invoices and payment records

7. Performance, Security & SEO

- Make both websites fast, secure and fully mobile-responsive

- Handle hosting, backups, SSL, domains and subdomains

- Implement technical SEO best practices so more students can find us on Google

Skills & Requirements

- 4 years of hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer

- Strong command of React. js and Next. js, along with JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS3 (Tailwind CSS is a plus)

- Backend development with Node. js (Express or NestJS) and building secure REST APIs

- Experience with databases such as MongoDB, PostgreSQL or MySQL

- Good working knowledge of WordPress, PHP and Elementor

- Experience integrating payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree or similar)

- Familiarity with authentication, user roles and secure handling of student data

- Deployment and hosting experience on AWS, Vercel, DigitalOcean, cPanel or VPS

- Comfortable with Git and version control

- Understanding of website performance optimisation and technical SEO

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects and meet deadlines

- Good communication skills to work closely with the academic and admin teams

Good to Have

- Experience working with OpenAI or other LLM APIs and building AI-based features

- Prior experience building an LMS, online exam platform or test series system

- Mobile app development with React Native or Flutter

- Experience in the EdTech sector

- Basic UI/UX design skills (Figma)

- Knowledge of analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console

Why Join Us

- Real impact: your work directly helps thousands of students reach their goals in UPSC, JEE and NEET

- Full ownership: you'll lead the tech for two growing institutions, not just one small feature

- Direct access to leadership: quick decisions, no layers of approval - your ideas get built fast

- Freedom to innovate: choose the right tools, suggest improvements and shape our tech roadmap

- Growth opportunity: as our digital platforms expand, so will your role and responsibilities

- A respected brand: work with an institute that has a 25+ year legacy in education

Salary: Negotiable (based on experience and skills)

Job Location: Old Rajinder Nagar, Karol Bagh, Delhi - 110060

Job Type: Full-time (Work from Office)

How to Apply

Apply directly through this post. Please make sure your profile includes your resume, along with links to your GitHub, portfolio and live projects you've built - this helps us understand your work better. 

We look forward to building the future of education with you!

 - Working with multi-agent orchestration, long-running agents, asynchronous workflows, or durable execution.

 - Building retrieval systems that use vector search, hybrid search, semantic indexing, ranking, or caching.

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader - we're changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We're committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. 

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work - every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. 

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. 

Job Type: Full-time

About The Team

Traffic Engineering powers secure, scalable, highly available traffic systems that support eBay's global commerce platform. We build and operate traffic management and security capabilities across edge and service layers, including PoP strategy, caching, Kubernetes networking, and reliability improvements based on monitoring insights. 

Role Summary

As a Traffic Engineering Architect, you will own architecture and technical direction across eBay's traffic engineering platform, spanning traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP/caching optimization, and traffic security (rate limiting, bot mitigation, etc. ). You will lead cross-team design, guide execution on critical initiatives, and drive measurable improvements in latency, availability, resilience, and security. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define architecture and technical strategy for global traffic systems: traffic management, load balancing, service connectivity, PoP optimization, caching, and traffic security controls. 
 - Architect and deliver rate limiting and bot mitigation solutions across edge/service layers in partnership with Security. 
 - Design and build high-performance, low-latency distributed systems using C/C++ and Go (Java in relevant components as needed). 
 - Drive Kubernetes networking and platform patterns at scale, including CNI integrations, service mesh, IPAM, and production-grade deployment models. 
 - Own technical tradeoffs across performance, scalability, reliability, security, operability, maintainability, and delivery timelines. 
 - Establish/advance observability and engineering metrics; use production signals to improve SLOs, reduce incidents, and increase efficiency. 
 - Lead operational excellence: incident prevention, resiliency design, capacity/performance tuning, and automated remediation where appropriate. 
 - Align roadmaps and execution across Product, Infrastructure, SRE/Operations, and Security; resolve cross-team dependencies and drive technical consensus. 
 - Mentor senior engineers/tech leads through architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews; raise engineering standards and consistency. 
 - Contribute to innovation via open-source engagement, patents, and forward-looking exploration relevant to traffic systems. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). 
 - 15+ years of software engineering experience with significant depth in networking/traffic engineering, distributed systems, and/or cyber security. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++ and Go (Java acceptable/valuable for specific subsystems); experience building production-grade, high-performance systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Linux networking, traffic management fundamentals, and systems performance optimization. 
 - Strong experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native infrastructure at scale. 
 - Proven experience designing secure, scalable, observable distributed platforms and operating them in production. 
 - Demonstrated cross-team technical leadership: driving architecture across multiple systems, influencing partners, and delivering large initiatives. 
 - Strong communication, mentoring, and technical decision-making skills in ambiguous environments. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Envoy, service mesh, control plane/data plane architectures, NGINX/HAProxy, SDN, eBPF, or comparable technologies. 
 - Experience with rate limiting, bot management, abuse prevention, and traffic security patterns (edge and service). 
 - Background in PoP design, caching strategies, and internet-scale traffic optimization. 
 - Vendor tool integration experience and operation in globally distributed environments. 
 - Open-source contributions, patents, or externally visible technical leadership. 

What Success Looks Like

- Improved global traffic platform outcomes (latency, throughput, availability, resilience, security). 
 - Reduced incident frequency/impact through architecture, observability, and operational rigor. 
 - Strong architectural alignment across teams with higher engineering quality and execution velocity.

industry-specific, delivering measurable results across how money moves, how assets

Domain depth. Enterprise scale. AI outcomes.

When a bank's payment doesn't move, someone has to find out why - in code they didn't

write, on servers they can't log into, with the bank on the line. We're hiring two people who

want to be that someone. 

Our payments platform moves money for large banks: microservices in Node. js, Go, Java

and Angular on MongoDB, NATS and Redis, running on Kubernetes. 

When a payment doesn't move, a fee doesn't post or a screen goes blank, you find out why

from the code, the data and the logs. Then you fix it so it can't happen again. 

What You'll Do

● Every production issue, end to end: from the bank's ticket to the fix running in their

release. 

● Hunt root causes. Triage bank tickets, reproduce the failure, find the cause in code, 

data and logs. When it's infra, network or a third party, prove it with evidence. 

● Read the data like a detective. Read-only MongoDB queries that show exactly what

happened. Audit live data (schedules, holidays, duplicates) before it hurts, and

reconcile it safely. 

● Make it fast. Slow screens, long-running queries, connection-pool leaks, end-of-day

CPU spikes, pod evictions: take each to a cause, then fix the query, the index or the

resource limit. 

● Ship the fix. Backport it across many live release lines, knowing its blast radius

before it goes out. 

● Pass the bank's scrutiny. Triage vulnerability-scan findings and answer audit

questionnaires. 

● Be the voice the bank trusts. Customer replies, RCAs, audit responses, weekly status

bank engineers and executives act on. Calm and clear on an incident call, and able to

explain a failure to an executive in two minutes. 

● A documenting habit. You leave runbooks, decision records and how-tos behind you, 

so nobody has to ask you twice.
